comment: Independent C-first check that a pet's move which kills the hero ends the monster's turn: a debug gnomish Healer wishes for and puts on a ring of conflict next to his little dog, rests, and lets its dogmove.c dog_move() ALLOW_U attack (mhitu.c mattacku()) kill him. He answers yes to the debug Die? and bones questions. end.c done() does not return in C, so monmove.c dochug()'s distfleeck() recalculation after m_move() never runs; the port must stop there as well.
